integrity: A mathematical all-size proof and parameter checks through side length 18 are supplied; finite computation is corroboration and not substituted for the all-size proof. No independent audit or external certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns uncoloured finite simple rectangular Cartesian grids and C2/one-dimensional colour refinement, not higher WL dimensions. Competing graphs need not remain bipartite. The unrestricted amenability characterization predates the present planar connected witnesses; independent priority confirmation is absent.
title: Planar colour-refinement twins of every nontrivial rectangular grid
